author: Weskerfan
quote: After waiting a decade for this game, I was left with disappointment. Previous GTA games were about doing stuff that let you escape reality. However, this game doesn't let you do the fun stuff that were a part in previous GTA games. Ladies of the night are no longer a thing. Gone are the car meets and adventures down a dark alley. And picking up a stripper to do stuff with is a no go in this GTA. I remember how in GTA 5 how any of the 3 playable characters could bag them a stripper. Michael was married and still could do whatever he wanted. But this game, you can't do that. Then there's a horrible FPS of this game. Like can't even get a smooth game without having crappy glitches popping up. And don't even bring up the lack of a physical disk. Don't waste money on this dud ****. Stick with GTA 5.

author: Weskerfan
quote: So this game has been a letdown. While some might love the game because college football is back, I'm holding this game to a higher standard. First, let's talk about the flaws. The glitches and horrible AI from Madden are all here in College Football 25. This makes the gameplay unbearable at times. Having players float and footballs magically hiked 50 yards behind you is just nuts. Not to mention the lack of control when wanting to run instead of pass with the QB.  Team building is kind of a joke as well, as you can't make edits to players.  However, the in-depth aspects of running your own college team is good. Notice I said good, not great. There's plenty of stuff missing that you could find in NCAA Football 14. While the game isn't everything I was hoping for, it does have some playablity when you aren't actually playing the game of college football.

author: Weskerfan
quote: Every year EA gives fans all these hollow promises. While some people see through the BS EA spoon feeds to people, other fall into the trap. This game keeps getting worse. So many glitches and horrible player logic. Save yourself the pain and suffering and avoid this game.

author: Weskerfan
quote: Madden 22 offers franchise players the coaching tree. A sad attempt to appease the franchise gamers. They also stole some of the interface from their NHL game and ported it over to Madden. It makes the user interface even worse now. And game play glitches are all over in this Madden. Some from Madden 21 make a return in the new Madden. Save your money, don't buy

author: Weskerfan
quote: A waste of money. Same glitches from Madden 21 show up in this new release. All EA has done is slap a little make up on the pig this time around, in hopes that you keep feeding their piggybank.

author: Weskerfan
quote: Holy horrible!!! There's so many glitches in this game!!! Some are glitches that were in last years Madden (can someone say copy and paste?). The soccer ball glitch is back. I mean it's nice if you wanted to play FIFA instead of picking up the fumbled football to take it to the house for a TD. There's also the new untackleable player glitch. There's the ghost that trips you up glitch. There's so many glitches that I can't name them all right here. This game is a total embarrassment to the NFL shield, an embarrassment to the NFL players,  and an embarrassment to it's fans

author: Weskerfan
quote: This game just keeps getting worse, even on next gen. There's still near 0 player logic. Blockers that give up on blocking, safeties not playing correctly against top tier receivers. This feels like another copy and paste year yet again for Madden. Save your money and wait for 2k to come out with their football game

author: Weskerfan
quote: A worse version of Madden than the one that's already out on current generation systems. Don't believe the one person that has given this game a good review. They work for EA and try to hype up the game. Instead, go to Ryan Moody's channel on YouTube and watch the horrible game play clips from this game.  It will save you time and money.

author: Weskerfan
quote: This game is somehow even worse on next gen systems. Kickers don't even have to make contact with the ball to make field goals. Game has 0 realism to it. Sad how 2k5 is light-years ahead of next gen Madden.

author: Weskerfan
quote: Madden 21 is even worse than previous Madden games. Want to see yard markers? Nope. Want to get more customized stuff in franchise? Nope. Want to get those extra MUT packs for buying the $100 version of Madden 21? Nope. Want to get online and not have a disconnect or glitchy game? Not happening today.

author: Weskerfan
quote: Spoiler alert! This game is hot garbage! Franchise was ignored, yet again. Then the roll out of the game for online was a complete disaster. Paid $100 to get the game early with all those extra MUT packs? Well sorry, the game isn't giving you those packs right now. Want to be able to see the yard markers? Well that isn't happening.  The only fun thing is you get FIFA 21 added to the game for free.Just another money grab from EA.

author: Weskerfan
quote: More **** for gambling than basketball. Stay away from getting this game.

author: Weskerfan
quote: The worse Madden to date!  EA continues to show they are more focused on soaking people's wallets via microtransactions than they are on creating a good game. Franchise as gotten worse and the game now has more bugs in it than Madden 19. After being promised that Madden would be bug free we found out that's a lie. Stay away from this dumper fire ****.
